messages:
maya: Quick snapshot: ran Amaru9b INT8 bringup on a 10k GTN request slice this morning. Results + notes below.

maya: baseline Amaru9b-FP16 (prod) -- p50 220ms, p95 490ms, tokens/sec 1500, cost/unit $0.008
maya: quant Amaru9b-INT8 -- p50 230ms, p95 520ms, tokens/sec 1400, cost/unit $0.0055
maya: quality (GTN eval): pass@1 delta -0.7% abs, hallucination rate +0.4pp on longform prompts (>1k tokens)
maya: latency tail moved ~+6% and we saw a ~5% memory spike during KV cache refill on cold starts
maya: takeaway: ~31% unit cost save vs FP16 but a small drop on longform quality; need product input on tradeoff

aj: nice. can we re-run with top_p=0.92? might recover pass@1 without blowing cost.
aj: also what was the batch config? did you enable prefix cache?

maya: batch=dynamic (cap=32), batch_concurrency_limit=2, prefix_cache=on only for warm requests; cold starts still pay the refill penalty
maya: re-run plan: top_p=0.92 + slice specifically for long-context >1k tokens tomorrow morning

lucas: +1 to testing priming sensitivity. product wants <0.5% quality delta on key tasks as a hard constraint.
lucas: can you also simulate iso-latency econ: what if we bump concurrency to 48 and lower batch cap? any perf regressions?

maya: quick sim: concurrency=48 + batch_cap=16 -> p50 210ms, p95 560ms (tail worse), cost/unit ~ $0.0052
maya: so non-linear tradeoff: median can improve but tail gets worse due to concurrent KV refills and recompute bursts

zara: product flagged routing idea: hybrid route where INT8 serves non-longform (80%) and FP16 fallback handles longform (20%). would that meet SLOs? rough calc -> ~22% overall saving

maya: sounds reasonable. propose rollout: canary 5% traffic, instrument GTN metrics (pass@1, hallucination, latency), then 25% with auto-rollback if >0.8% pass@1 drift or hallucination spike

aj: add canary policy checks: (1) pass@1 delta, (2) hallucination increase, (3) p95 latency > baseline +15% => rollback. also capture token-level diffs (top-3) for sampled requests

lucas: any sign of quant artifacts in logits / token ordering? did you capture examples?

maya: saw low-rank logit shifts on some templates; small reorderings on function words in long contexts. sample below:

maya: ```
# sample token probs (FP16 vs INT8)
# context: long prompt (1.2k tokens)
FP16: 'the' 0.12, 'a' 0.05, 'it' 0.04
INT8: 'the' 0.10, 'a' 0.06, 'it' 0.05
# note: small reordering on function words, amplified with longer contexts / repeated priming
```

dev-bot: deploy-checklist: canary policy created: amaru9b-int8-hybrid-canary-v1

zara: ok let's sync with product tomorrow 10am. maya please prepare an exec one-pager: cost delta, risk, rollback criteria, and a brief scorecard

maya: will do. I'll include final GTN numbers after the top_p rerun and a short scorecard + recommended routing flags

lucas: if rerun shows >0.5% pass@1 delta we'll hold hybrid and try int6 or mixed-precision instead

maya: noted. dropping artifacts to gs://redwood-eval/amaru9b/int8/gtneval_2026-03-22.csv and logs to /tmp/amaru9b-int8-samples.log
maya: any objections to naming the routing flag `amaru9b:int8-hybrid`?

aj: fine by me :thumbsup:
zara: no objections :eyes:
maya: thanks all.
